memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: On the first of every month, present to the LORD a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect. With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, a grain offering of two-tenths; and with each lamb, a grain offering of a tenth. This is for a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the LORD. - Num 28:11-13 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
At the start of each month, Israel brought a special offering to mark the new beginning. The monthly rhythm of worship reminded the people that every season belonged to God. As the moon renewed and a new month began, they turned again to the Lord who governs all their times.

There is wisdom in marking the passage of time with worship. Days, weeks, and now months were all framed by turning to God. This kept Israel from drifting through life unaware of God's presence. Each new month was an occasion to remember afresh that their time was a gift from Him and that He was faithful through every season.

These offerings, like the others, belonged to the ceremonial law of the old covenant and are fulfilled in Christ. We do not bring monthly bulls and lambs. Yet the principle of consecrating our time to God endures. It is good to pause at the turning of seasons and remember that all our days are in His hands.

Every new beginning is an invitation to entrust our time to the Lord. In Christ, we know that the God who holds our months and years is working all things for our good (Rom 8:28). As each new month begins, we can commit it to Him, trusting His faithfulness for whatever it holds. Give your time to the God who gave His Son for you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you consecrate your time and seasons to God?
2. How might you mark new beginnings by turning to the Lord?
3. What comfort do you find in knowing all your days are in God's hands?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, all my times are in Your hands. As each new season begins, help me to entrust my days to You, trusting Your faithfulness and remembering that You hold my every moment in Christ. Amen.
